name: FMC Germany 2019

venue.name: [VHS Dortmund](https://vhs.dortmund.de/index.php?id=124)
venue.details: Room S139b (on intermediate level between 1st and 2nd floor)

information:
**Important:** This is **not** a typical Speedcubing-Competition and not suitable for spectators. The competition only features the event "Fewest Moves". We do not hold the event "3x3x3 Cube". You can find other German competitions [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=✓&region=Germany&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

The entrance fee for competitors is 15 Euro for the competition with pre-payment. There is no entrance fee for guests, but guests will be asked to leave the room during attempts!
